title: Vectorial bent-negabent functions entirely outside MM-sharp
summary: Determine whether a vectorial bent-negabent function can have every nonzero component outside the completed Maiorana--McFarland class.

formal_statement.body: Does there exist an admissible pair $(m,k)$ and a vectorial bent-negabent function $F:\mathbb F_2^{2m}\to\mathbb F_2^k$ such that, for every $0\ne\lambda\in\mathbb F_2^k$, the Boolean component $F_\lambda(x)=\lambda\cdot F(x)$ lies outside the completed Maiorana--McFarland class $\mathcal{MM}^{\#}$? Construct and verify one such $F$, or prove nonexistence.

scope.domain: Vectorial bent-negabent Boolean functions and completed-class exclusion
assumptions: $m$ and $k$ satisfy the source's admissible vectorial bent-negabent dimension conditions
scope.unresolved_remainder: Later papers construct scalar bent functions outside $\mathcal{MM}^{\#}$ and vectorial examples with only some excluded components. No inspected result gives one vectorial bent-negabent function whose every nonzero component is outside the completed class.

citations.label: Pasalic--Kudin--Polujan--Pott, vectorial bent-negabent open problems
citations.locator: Open Problem IV.1, Remark IV.2, and conclusion, journal pp. 2710-2712

progress.summary: The conclusion identifies construction of a vectorial bent-negabent function with all nonzero components outside the completed Maiorana--McFarland class as the next difficult open problem.
